The '''Bedlam system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Thusa sector/Legends|Thusa sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bedlam/Legends|Bedlam]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
By placing both the [[Bedlam Pulsar/Legends|Bedlam Pulsar]] and the Bedlam system in its list, [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] indicates the Bedlam Pulsar is not in the Bedlam system.
